result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed. The main visual defect is a failed/missing hero image on the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section, which shows a gray placeholder with a broken-image icon instead of a photo.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section displays a broken/missing image placeholder (gray box with a generic image icon) instead of the restaurant photo, making the card look broken and less appealing.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL or asset loading for this restaurant, and provide a branded fallback image (e.g., cuisine-type illustration or restaurant logo) when the photo fails to load instead of a raw placeholder icon.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) button on the broken Tokumaru Ramen Bar card sits on a light gray placeholder background, where its semi-transparent gray circle has low contrast and is barely distinguishable.
issues.suggestion: Ensure overlay controls like the favorite button use a background/border with sufficient contrast regardless of the underlying image (e.g., a darker scrim or outlined style).
